limitations: No actual research/shadow/paper track record or calibration evidence was fabricated. Recorded imports retain supplied provenance and do not certify it.
Intervals are approximate descriptive normal mean intervals; independence, autocorrelation and repeated-comparison limits are disclosed.
Slippage is per terminal entry order versus the last completed decision close, not NBBO/arrival-price execution quality. Pending orders are excluded from rejection rates.
Peer-input age does not cover every news/model feature's freshness. Research execution/freshness comparisons remain unavailable without recorded samples.
API downtime stops collection/scheduling. Telemetry and source observation windows are bounded. Immutable review history consumes disk over time and requires backup/monitoring.
Browser verification used local Chrome and isolated HTTP fixtures; actual broker compatibility, paper soak and other browsers/physical devices remain outside this implementation verification.
